# kaviri

> kaviri is an open-source recording browser that films product demo videos from a script in
> your repository. You write what happens as newline-delimited JSON ops; kaviri drives its own
> Chromium over the DevTools protocol, derives the camera zooms and pans from the interactions,
> and renders a finished H.264 MP4. Because the script lives next to the code, CI re-records the
> video on every change and the build fails when the take filmed nothing. One Rust binary,
> Apache 2.0, no account, nothing phones home.

kaviri is ChiShona for "twice, a second time", pronounced ka-VEE-ree.

Key facts:

- Runs on Linux and macOS. Needs a Chromium (90+) and ffmpeg with libx264 on PATH.
- Install: `git clone https://github.com/kaviridev/kaviri && cd kaviri && cargo build --release`.
- Record: `kaviri record --script demo.jsonl --out demo.mp4`.
- GitHub Action: `uses: kaviridev/kaviri@v1` with `script`, `out` and `preset` inputs.
- AI agents: `kaviri mcp` is a Model Context Protocol server (open, inspect, record_demo,
  previews). Agents with only a shell can follow the op protocol in llms-full.txt.
- Output presets: desktop, readme, tiktok, reels, shorts, square, landscape, phone. Device
  frames: macos, windows, linux, ios, android, android-emulator, ios-simulator.
- Pricing: the recorder is free forever (Apache 2.0). A hosted service that returns an MP4 at a
  stable URL opens as a beta in December 2026, billed per render minute.
- Source: https://github.com/kaviridev/kaviri. Contact: hello@kaviri.dev.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://kaviri.dev/docs/): what it is, what a script looks like, how to run one.
- [Script protocol](https://kaviri.dev/docs/script-protocol/): every op and field (frame, navigate, wait, start_recording, click, hover, type, press, scroll, mark, say, voice, inspect, stop_recording).
- [The camera](https://kaviri.dev/docs/camera/): how zooms and pans are derived from interactions.
- [In CI](https://kaviri.dev/docs/ci/): the GitHub Action and the checks that fail a build on an empty take.
- [MCP server](https://kaviri.dev/docs/mcp/): the op protocol as MCP tools for agents.
- [Sound and captions](https://kaviri.dev/docs/audio/): narration, a ducking music bed, timed captions.
- [Troubleshooting](https://kaviri.dev/docs/troubleshooting/): what each error means.
- [For agents](https://kaviri.dev/docs/agents/): the whole protocol for an agent with a shell.

## Optional

- [Agent guide, full text](https://kaviri.dev/llms-full.txt): the op protocol in one plain-text file.
- [Playground](https://kaviri.dev/play/): edit a script and watch the camera in the browser.
- [Company](https://kaviri.dev/company/): who makes kaviri.
